objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other controlled content objects that pass through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archival lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit sequential number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date (Valid From + validity period).

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time span for validity (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Retention period after invalidation (default 10 years).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Applicable scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT application master data.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas for which the document applies.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client visibility assignment in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document; released together with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status aligned with the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Non-controlled supplementary material (e.g. screenshots, brief instructions) added to a document without triggering a new version or requiring formal release.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal request to amend an existing released document, created by any author and tracked until completion.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Planned, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, processed via workflow to extend or revise validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Formal request to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document processes in various roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign collective read or change authorizations and distribution memberships.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Configuration of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that orchestrates sequential steps (e.g. Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digitally captured signature of a workflow participant documenting their approval or rejection at a workflow step.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

objs.name: document_type_configuration
objs.description: System-level configuration defining a document type including its abbreviation, numbering scheme, default validity period, archive duration and available templates.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code for the document type.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: Standard extended validity duration (e.g. 3 years).

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: Standard archive retention period (e.g. 10 years).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected document type for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The author or co-author modifies the content of a document using the integrated editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the system automatically converts the document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or co-author initiates the 3-step approval workflow (Creator – Review – Release).

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication, completing the task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, cancelling subsequent workflow tasks.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document achieves Released status after successful completion of the approval workflow and is published to readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes or planned change proposals.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Non-controlled supplementary information is attached to a document without affecting its version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is removed from a document directly without affecting the document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the resolution of a change proposal; the proposal creator is notified.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) confirms the document remains valid, resetting the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and initiate the override workflow.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally reviewer/initiator) confirms the invalidation of the document through the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document's last released version is set to Out of Force status, rights are revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the archived document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to a document via user groups or individual person assignments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to a document's distribution list for email notification or acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon document release, email notifications are sent to users and groups on the distribution list.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the acknowledgement distribution list receive a workflow task to confirm they have read the document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via workflow.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator creates a language-dependent version of a released document.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version passes through review and release workflow and becomes visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, releases or pending actions.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (e.g. workflow task, release info, validity extension info).

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive duration expires, the archived document is permanently deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment is a controlled sub-document that belongs to and is released with a specific main Document.
Additional Info is supplementary material linked to a Document without affecting its versioning.
A Change Proposal is created for and belongs to a specific Document.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
A Request for Override is created for a specific Document to initiate invalidation.
A Request for Reactivation references the archived Document to be reactivated.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original, or cross-references).
One or more Document Templates are defined for each Document Type Configuration.
A User is a member of one or more User Groups for authorization and role assignment.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to control notification and acknowledgement upon release.
A Distribution List includes User Groups whose members receive notifications or acknowledgement requests.
A Distribution List can include individual Users directly.
A User Group is assigned to a Document to grant read or change authorizations.
